other_failure_modes.name: Un-transformed skewed target
other_failure_modes.description: The target variable is a financial amount, which is typically heavily right-skewed. The agent predicts this raw value directly without applying a log-transform or similar normalization, making the RMSE metric overly sensitive to large outliers.

other_failure_modes.name: Improper handling of missing dates
other_failure_modes.description: When converting datetimes to timestamps, pandas converts NaT (missing dates) into extreme negative integers. Passing these extreme values into the model as features creates artificial outliers that can distort learning.

summary: The agent provides a mostly standard LightGBM regression pipeline with cross-validation. However, it introduces data leakage by computing frequency encodings on the combined train and test sets, and fails to respect temporal ordering in its cross-validation strategy despite extracting date features. Furthermore, it does not address the likely skewness of the financial target variable, which can harm RMSE optimization.
